nodes.description: Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders and otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary caller-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale from token amounts and setting _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer loop multiplying _value by _tos.length and emitting duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation from factory and token pair.
Constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender, setting owner, metadata and infinite UNI allowance.
Private owner address set to msg.sender; gates every privileged function.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances mutated by transferFrom/batchSend/constructor.
Public nested mapping of allowances mutated by approve/transferFrom/constructor.
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure.
Private minimum sale amount set by init and checked by condition.
Private maximum sale amount set by init and checked by condition.
Private per-address sale count limit set by init and checked by condition.
Address whitelisted in ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
Public constant decimals (18) used to scale supplies in constructor and init.
Public total supply set in constructor.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap Router address whitelisted in ensure.
Externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance spenders and balance debits.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary untrusted code in the contract storage context.
total = _value * _tos.length performed without SafeMath, wrappable.
Raw allowance/balance decrements (allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; balanceOf[_from] -= _value) without SafeMath.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, used in unchecked decrements.
Source address parameter of ensure, compared against whitelist.
Amount parameter of ensure forwarded to condition.
Address parameter of condition used for _onSaleNum lookup.
Amount parameter of condition compared to _minSale/_maxSale.
Arbitrary target address of delegatecall supplied by the owner.
Arbitrary calldata bytes supplied to delegatecall.
Sale count limit parameter of init written to _saleNum.
Minimum token amount parameter of init scaled into _minSale.
Maximum token amount parameter of init scaled into _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses iterated in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length.
New trade address written to tradeAddress.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address compared against _from.
Local total computed as _value * _tos.length.
Loop index over _tos.
Loop-local recipient taken from _tos.

edges.reason: delegate is guarded only by msg.sender == owner, which is the sole protection for the arbitrary delegatecall.
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _from and spends allowance[_from][msg.sender].
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
approve keys the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, the root of trust for all privileged paths.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure computes the pair address via pairFor for whitelist comparison.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
condition reads _minSale to bound the sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the sale amount.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale limit.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it with _saleNum.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom performs raw unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
delegate triggers an external delegatecall that can re-enter the contract with full storage control.
Owner-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall.
Owner-supplied calldata b is executed in the contract context.
init writes _minSale derived from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale derived from maxToken.
init writes _saleNum from saleNum.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each balanceOf[_to].
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor sets owner to the deployer msg.sender.
Constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals.
Constructor sets name.
Constructor sets symbol.
ensure whitelists _from when canSale/_onSaleNum state marks it as allowed.
ensure consults canSale[_from] for the whitelist shortcut.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress for the whitelist shortcut.
The locally computed _UNI pair address is compared with _from inside ensure.
Local total is the overflow-prone product used for the balance check in batchSend.
Loop index i drives the unbounded batchSend iteration over _tos.
Loop-local _to receives balance in batchSend.
_from parameter drives the allowance and balance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the operand of the unchecked decrements in transferFrom.
ensure._from is the address checked against the whitelist conditions.
ensure._value is forwarded to condition for range validation.
condition._from indexes _onSaleNum.
condition._value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
token is multiplied by 10**decimals to form _minSale in init.
maxToken is multiplied by 10**decimals to form _maxSale in init.
_tos.length is a multiplication operand for total in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by the array length in batchSend.
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: transferFrom._from is an argument of the transferFrom function and has no independent semantics.
transferFrom._to is an argument of the transferFrom function.
transferFrom._value is the arithmetic operand of the unchecked decrement in transferFrom.
ensure._from is an argument of the ensure function.
ensure._value is an argument forwarded by ensure to condition.
condition._from is an argument of the condition function.
condition._value is an argument of the condition function.
delegate.a is the attacker-controlled target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegate.b is the attacker-controlled calldata of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
init.saleNum is stored directly into the _saleNum state variable by init.
init.token is scaled into the _minSale state variable by init.
init.maxToken is scaled into the _maxSale state variable by init.
batchSend._tos is the iterated array parameter of batchSend.
batchSend._value is the multiplicand of the overflow-prone total computation.
setTradeAddress.addr is stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
ensure._UNI is a temporary address computed inside ensure for the whitelist check.
batchSend.total is a temporary product used inside batchSend.
batchSend.i is the loop counter of batchSend.
batchSend._to is a loop-local recipient used inside batchSend.
